decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is a multi-model line at the core of the firm's formwork know-how and had its own page in both years, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it through its own engineering and research.
Shuttering magnet blocks are a standard consumable in precast plants and build directly on the firm's magnetic formwork expertise, giving steady demand that its existing knowledge base can support.
This magnetic formwork component had a dedicated page in 2018 and 2019, which signals commercial relevance, and it fits closely with the firm's established knowledge in shuttering technology.

It is only mentioned rather than featured, and the related magnetic strips line was already withdrawn, but it is closely related to core competencies and cheap to keep in the portfolio, so retention is more likely than not.
